episodes.211360: An upper level trough and low level trough to the northwest of Hawaii brought numerous flooding impacts. These flooding impacts closed roads and damaged property across the state.
episodes.213222: Strong thunderstorms moved across South Florida on April 8, 2026. A mesoscale area of low pressure followed the earlier round of storms producing widespread strong winds across the area.
episodes.213223: Strong thunderstorms moved across South Florida and the adjacent Atlantic waters on April 8, 2026. A mesoscale area of low pressure followed the earlier round of storms producing widespread strong winds across the area.

events.narrative: Heavy rain developed over the southeastern slopes of the Big Island and led to flooding impacts. Water was reportedly flowing into a house in the Puna district near Hawaiian Paradise Park. Water also accumulated on Highway 11 near mile marker 60. Hao Springs Road closed due to flooding.
